options.help: The name displayed to consumers of the setting in all user interfaces where settings are displayed.

The unique name of the setting in an environment. If not provided, the name is automatically generated based on the display name provided but can be changed before the setting is created. Once a setting is created, the Name can't be changed as it may be referenced in applications or code. Name has a prefix that corresponds to the solution publisher. This prefix is intended to give the setting a unique name if you want to import them into another solution or environment in the future (which would have a different prefix).
A description of the setting that helps others understand what the setting is used for in all user interfaces where settings are displayed.
The data type of a setting controls how the setting’s value is stored. Data type can be set to Number, String, or Yes/No. Data type can't be changed after the setting is created.

The default value of the setting. It specifies the setting's value that will be used unless it is overridden by a setting environment value or a setting app value. It should match the setting type. For booleans you can also provide an int value: 0 means false, any other value means true.

Release level is used to inform the framework and other consumers of the setting about the state of the feature that the setting is used with. Release level can be set to Generally available or Preview.
A link to documentation to help consumers of the setting understand the purpose of the setting. Will be used as a Learn more link in all user interfaces where settings are displayed.
The solution where to save the created setting. If not specified, the default solution is considered.

commands.help: Creates a copy of a given view.

options.help: The display name of the view to clone.
The new name of the view. If not provided, a suffix will be set by default.
The name of the table that contains the view. Required only if the view name is not unique in the system.
The type of query.
Indicates that during the clone operation, all the filters applied on the previous view must be removed from the new view.
Specifies the name of the solution that will contain the view after the creation. If not specified, the default solution for the current environment is used.

options.help: The display name of the view to retrieve.

options.help: The table name for which to list the views

options.help: The display name of the view to rename.

The type of query.

commands.help: Replicates the structure (layout and sort order) of a given view.

options.help: The name of the view to replicate
The name of the table that contains the view. Required only if the view name is not unique in the system.

commands.help: Adds an external web resource to the current webresource project **as a reference**, without copying it locally.

options.help: The absolute or relative URL of the web resource to add as reference to the current project.
The target URL of the webresource, relative to the root of the dataverse WebResources. It must include the publisher prefix.
The folder containing the .wr.pacx project where the reference should be added. If not specified, the command will find it recoursing up from the current folder.
The name of the solution that will contain the WebResources. If empty, the default solution for the current environment is used as default

commands.help: (Preview) Applies icons to custom tables, starting from a given solution

options.help: The name of the solution that contains the tables to update with icons. If not specified, the default solution is considered.
The name of the solution that contains the web resources to set. If not specified, the default solution is considered.
If specified, the command will not perform any action, but it will show what it would do.

commands.help: Set-up the folder that will host the Dataverse WebResources

options.help: The folder where the webresources will be stored. If not provided, the current folder will be used.
Indicates that the folder will be set-up synchronizing the webresources from the Dataverse environment
In case you want to init the folder from the contents of a solution that is not the default one for the current environment, specifies the name of the solution to take as source

commands.help: (Preview) Creates a new Javascript webresource from a template

options.help: Indicates if the JS web resource to create is for a form, a ribbon command, or other
Name of the table related to the JS. Mandatory for form JS. Optional for Ribbon JS (if not specified, is assumed as a global ribbon command). Must not be specified for Other JS.
Namespace for the generated webresources. If not specified, the **uniquename** of the default solution publisher will be used.
The name of the solution that will contain the creted WebResource. Is used to deduct the namespace, if not explicitly set.

commands.help: Allows to restore the default templates used for JS WebResources to the one shipped by default by PACX.

options.help: The type of the template to restore.

commands.help: Allows to override the default template used when creating custom JS WebResources.

options.help: The name of the file that contains the new template
The type of the template to override.

commands.help: Push web resources from a local folder to the target environment

options.help: The path to the folder containing the webresources to deploy, or to a specific webresource file to deploy. If not provided, the current folder will be used.

If specified, the command will not perform any action, but it will show what it would do.

commands.help: Sets the image that will be shown in the top left corner of the title bar. This setting applies for all MDAs of a given environment.

options.help: The unique name of the web resource to set as the organization image. Must be a .png, .jpg or .gif image up to 200x48px.
Optional appmodule id. If provided, updates CustomThemeDefinition at app level.
Optional app unique/display name. If provided, updates CustomThemeDefinition at app level.
Optional path to a local theme.xml file to update and/or push.
Optional base palette color for the selected app or environment theme. Required when a new theme file must be created; otherwise the logo will not appear.
The solution where to save the theme webresource and setting. If not specified, the default solution is considered.

commands.help: Returns a list of workflows (Power Automate Flow)

options.help: The unique name (or part of it) of the workflow to retrieve

The solution that contains the workflows to return. If not provided, the default solution is used. Pass * to avoid filtering by solution.
